claim.description: the hypothesis in one or two plain sentences, as the assessment states it

conditions.description: the intended applicability conditions, in prose

subject.description: {family, product, group?, version?, kind?, path?, name?, component?}; the fields a family takes: crd-field (group, kind, path; version?), helm-value (path), cli-flag (name), env-var (name), feature-gate (name), config-key (path), gvk (version, kind), image (name), protocol-behavior (name), api-endpoint (name), migration (name), …

change.description: {type, before?, after?, replacedBy?}; default-changed and value-changed take before and after (JSON-encoded scalars); renamed takes replacedBy (a subject)

exposure.description: a condition of the fact grammar: {op, of?, group?, version?, kind?, name?, path?, component?, state?, values?, pattern?, separator?, range?, reason?, needed?, default?}. Combinators all/any (one or more operands in `of`) and not (exactly one); `resource` (kind, group?, version?, name?) scopes `field` (path; state unset|set|equals|not-equals|matches|has-token|has-token-key), `text-line` (path, pattern; state exists|none) and `ref` (path, kind?, group?) to one object of that kind; environment-wide leaves values-key, cli-flag, env-var, feature-gate, gvk-in-use, image-in-use, product-version, cluster-version, edge-from-version, rendered-change; `undecidable` (reason, needed) is always unknown. equals/not-equals values are JSON-encoded ("\"Never\"", "true"). In an undecidable leaf, `needed` is the id of the uncertainty it keeps (or, for a new gap, what is needed to decide it). A `field`, `cli-flag` or `env-var` leaf with a value state (equals, not-equals, matches, has-token, has-token-key) may state `default`: {value (JSON-encoded), source crd-schema|controller, citations: upstream evidence ids that establish what an unset field holds}.

overlap.description: a condition of the fact grammar: {op, of?, group?, version?, kind?, name?, path?, component?, state?, values?, pattern?, separator?, range?, reason?, needed?, default?}. Combinators all/any (one or more operands in `of`) and not (exactly one); `resource` (kind, group?, version?, name?) scopes `field` (path; state unset|set|equals|not-equals|matches|has-token|has-token-key), `text-line` (path, pattern; state exists|none) and `ref` (path, kind?, group?) to one object of that kind; environment-wide leaves values-key, cli-flag, env-var, feature-gate, gvk-in-use, image-in-use, product-version, cluster-version, edge-from-version, rendered-change; `undecidable` (reason, needed) is always unknown. equals/not-equals values are JSON-encoded ("\"Never\"", "true"). In an undecidable leaf, `needed` is the id of the uncertainty it keeps (or, for a new gap, what is needed to decide it). A `field`, `cli-flag` or `env-var` leaf with a value state (equals, not-equals, matches, has-token, has-token-key) may state `default`: {value (JSON-encoded), source crd-schema|controller, citations: upstream evidence ids that establish what an unset field holds}.

consequence.description: {kind, exposedClass, statement?, remediation?, severity?}; the class follows the kind: upgrade-blocked, resource-rejected, setting-ignored, permission-lost, workload-failure, migration-required → action-required (statement required); behavior-change, deprecation, superseded-upstream → review-required; none → informational

statement.description: the rule in one plain sentence

release.description: from = the last version with the old behaviour (exclusive), to = the first version with the new one (inclusive); within the transition

rule.description: kind rule: the complete, decidable rule; kind unrepresentable: the rule as far as the grammar can carry it, or null

environmentBasis.description: kind rule: ids from `environmentBasis`; otherwise empty

requestedVerification.description: kind rule: what an independent check must show, with and without the condition; otherwise empty

limitation.description: kind unrepresentable: the specific grammar limitation; otherwise empty

proposedVerification.description: kind unrepresentable: how the claim can be verified; otherwise empty

keeps.description: kind unrepresentable: ids of the uncertainties this record keeps; otherwise empty

discharges.description: ids of the `default` uncertainties the rule settles with an evidenced default (a value leaf's `default`); otherwise empty

noHypothesisReason.description: only when hypotheses is empty: why the assessment states no testable hypothesis

roleDefaults.description: what an unset consumer-role field means, only where `evidence` holds upstream text that establishes it (empty otherwise)

path.description: a role field path of one of `consumerRoles`

value.description: the JSON-encoded value an unset field holds

citations.description: upstream evidence ids from `evidence` that establish the default
